purpose: Single frozen hash configuration comparison; not min-wise-family probability estimation.
selection_of_configuration: Repository default seed 42; not selected by screening results. Legacy seed has occurred in earlier experiments. This is not an externally preregistered study.
fasta_handling: Reset at non-ACGT and every record boundary; uppercase/lowercase equivalent; circular wraparound excluded.
frequency_scope: all records of each uploaded assembly including organelles, independently counted before selection
assessment_window: equal to sampling w; compare methods only within same w
new_code: frozen table serialization/loading and fixed-parameter wrapper; production generation and score code unchanged
not_claimed: min-wise probability estimates from one fixed window
